title: Machine profile registry
done_when: Family binaries and shared tooling can select a machine by MachineId and ModelId, and each selected profile declares clocks, firmware requirements, media slots, and default input layout.

title: Time contract
done_when: MachineTime, ClockDesc, and run_until(target_time) exist and one headless harness can drive a core without knowing its scheduler internals.

title: Media model
done_when: Cartridge, tape, floppy, and firmware images can be described uniformly as host-owned media objects without forcing a shared in-core media API.

title: Video sink
done_when: A core can emit completed frames, and beam or scanline machines have an optional lower-level event sink.

title: Audio sink
done_when: Cores can emit timestamped audio packets into a shared host sink.

title: Input model
done_when: Host input can be sampled and mapped into machine-local input adapters without shared keyboard matrix or controller abstractions.

title: Snapshot contract
done_when: A core can serialize and restore a versioned snapshot blob under one shared envelope format.

title: Trace and validation harness
done_when: Scripted input playback, framebuffer capture, audio capture, and timestamped trace events all exist in one reusable harness.

title: DMG profile and media path
done_when: DMG-01 can boot from configured boot ROM policy and cartridge media in its family binary through the shared media-loading support.

title: SM83 and interrupt baseline
done_when: CPU fetch and execute, interrupts, and reset sequencing run under the shared support contract.

title: DMG memory, timer, joypad, serial stub
done_when: Baseline memory map, timer behavior, joypad reads, and a non-blocking serial placeholder exist.

title: PPU to frame sink
done_when: Visible frame output, VBlank signaling, and framebuffer capture work through the shared sink.

title: APU and validation pass
done_when: Audio packets are emitted through the shared audio sink and the baseline validation set passes in the shared harness.

title: SG-1000 profile and cartridge path
done_when: SG-1000 is pinned as the initial Sega 8-bit profile and cartridges load through the shared media-loading support.

title: Z80 integration and memory map
done_when: CPU execution, memory mapping, and interrupt entry run under the shared support contract.

title: VDP baseline
done_when: Tile and sprite display reaches the frame sink and a first screenshot-based regression set exists.

title: PSG, controllers, and pause path
done_when: Controller state and audio emission work through shared sinks without platform-local host hacks.

title: Validation and Master System delta backlog
done_when: SG-1000 baseline tests run in the shared harness and the Master System 1 delta is captured as explicit follow-up tickets.

title: Spectrum 48K profile, ROM, and tape path
done_when: Spectrum 48K boots its ROM and can consume a basic tape image path through shared media plumbing.

title: Z80 plus ULA contention
done_when: CPU execution observes ULA-visible contention rules rather than a pure unconstrained tick loop.

title: Bitmap video, keyboard matrix, and beeper
done_when: Keyboard input, beeper output, and visible display all flow through the shared support interfaces.

title: Tape timing and validation
done_when: At least one deterministic tape-load validation case passes in the shared harness.

title: Spectrum 128K extension
done_when: The 128K paging model and AY audio path exist as a second supported profile within the same family shell.

title: Front-loader NTSC profile and mapper-limited cartridge path
done_when: An NTSC NES baseline profile loads NROM, UxROM, CNROM, and MMC1 media through one cartridge path.

title: 2A03 CPU, interrupts, and DMA foundation
done_when: CPU execution, interrupts, OAM DMA, and core bus timing run under the shared support contract.

title: PPU baseline to frame sink
done_when: Background and sprite output, VBlank timing, and framebuffer capture work through the common video path.

title: APU and controller path
done_when: Baseline APU channels and controller polling reach the shared support sinks.

title: Mapper and validation pass
done_when: The wave-1 mapper set passes a shared regression harness and no generic cross-system mapper API has leaked into the architecture.

title: C64 PAL profile and media path
done_when: A PAL C64 profile loads cartridge and one practical program-loading path through the shared media-loading support.

title: 6510, banking, CIA baseline
done_when: CPU execution, banking, timers, and keyboard or joystick-visible CIA behavior exist.

title: VIC-II badlines, raster IRQs, and frame output
done_when: Badlines, raster IRQ timing, and visible output all operate through the shared video contract.

title: SID and input
done_when: SID output and keyboard or joystick input reach the shared sinks without family-specific frontend hacks.

title: Validation pass
done_when: A first raster- and timing-sensitive regression set passes under the shared harness.

title: Atari 2600 NTSC profile and minimal bankswitch path
done_when: 2K, 4K, and F8 cartridges load through the shared media-loading support.

title: 6507 and RIOT baseline
done_when: CPU execution, RIOT timer behavior, and input-visible state run under the common time contract.

title: TIA beam, collisions, and audio
done_when: Beam-driven rendering, collision state, and audio emission all operate through shared sinks.

title: Controller set and validation
done_when: Joystick baseline input and one deterministic validation set run under the common harness.

title: CoreGrafx profile and HuCard media path
done_when: CoreGrafx is the pinned wave-1 profile and HuCards load through the shared media-loading support.

title: HuC6280, memory map, timer, and IRQ baseline
done_when: CPU execution, timing, interrupts, and baseline bank mapping run correctly under the common time contract.

title: VDC/VCE video path
done_when: Visible output reaches the shared frame sink with timing-aware scanline behavior.

title: PSG and controller path
done_when: Audio packets and controller state run through shared support plumbing.

title: Validation pass
done_when: A first regression set passes and all CD-related work remains explicitly deferred.

title: Amiga 500 OCS PAL profile, Kickstart, and floppy path
done_when: An Amiga 500 OCS PAL profile can boot with declared firmware and floppy media through the shared host support layer.

title: 68000, memory map, and interrupt foundation
done_when: CPU execution, exceptions, and baseline memory behavior operate under the shared time contract.

title: DMA scheduler skeleton
done_when: The Amiga core has an explicit DMA or arbiter scheduling model rather than a CPU-centric bus loop.

title: Agnus and Denise video path with Copper and bitplanes
done_when: Visible display, Copper effects, and bitplane output reach the shared frame sink.

title: Paula audio, CIA, keyboard, and floppy timing
done_when: Audio output and baseline machine input and peripheral timing operate through shared sinks and adapters.

title: Blitter and validation pass
done_when: One deterministic boot or demo validation set passes under the shared harness.

title: Shared tooling and startup conventions
done_when: Completed wave-1 binaries share startup conventions and can be driven by common tooling without a monolithic launcher.

title: Snapshot and restore smoke tests across wave 1
done_when: Every completed wave-1 family has at least one automated save-state round-trip test.

title: Trace and regression matrix
done_when: Each completed family participates in one shared regression matrix with artifacts produced in a uniform format.
